title: Bake & Mystery Challenge
meta: About 45–50 min, plus each extra oven load

blocks.title: Safety first
blocks.text: Check your school’s food requirements and every student’s allergies and dietary needs against each ingredient label, including any Mystery ingredient. Only adults handle the oven and hot pans.

items: Book the oven and an adult to run it for the whole session
Confirm whether students may eat what they bake, and when
Shop from the recipe card: one recipe per team makes about 12–18 standard cupcakes
Each team: mixing bowl, square pan (recipe step 3), measuring cups and spoons, fork, cupcake pan, liners, toothpick
Hand-washing and cleaning supplies, oven mitts, and a safe place for hot pans
Plan for cooling: cupcakes won’t be cool by the end of the session, so decide when they are eaten, iced or taken home
Mystery: choose one twist (below) and prepare it

items.title: Roles
items.text: Teams choose roles: Leader, Reader, Ingredient Manager, Mixer, Timekeeper, Clean-Up Crew. Small teams combine roles. Everyone washes hands.

items.title: Measure and mix
items.text: An adult preheats the oven to 350°F (175°C). Teams follow the recipe and fill liners about ¾ full.

items.title: Bake
items.text: Only an adult loads and unloads the oven. Teams wash up while it bakes. Each extra oven load adds 20–25 min.
Halfway through mixing, every student takes a new role.
Remove one mixing tool. Never limit oven mitts or safety equipment.
Only after the allergy check above. Prepare one portion per team.

blocks.text: Icing-colour and design twists need frosting and cooled cupcakes, so save them for a later session.

items.text: Stagger teams by a few minutes so pans are ready when the oven is.
Pause, reread the step together and ask an adult before changing anything.
Remind the team the goal is adapting, not a perfect cupcake.

items: Students follow their roles and support each other.
Mystery: teams adapt to the twist without unapproved ingredients.
